maria (Sales): Quick sync — Helios Health asked for one final performance run before legal signs off. They want mixed workload (embeddings for search + generation for summaries) with realistic prompt lengths, and a firm POC cost for 2 weeks. Can we scope a load plan and call out any enterprise blockers?

alex (Solutions): Thanks — I can own the run plan. Need answers on: model proxy (open model or Redwood-provided), typical prompt tokens & summary length, target sustained QPS and expected burst pattern, and whether they require customer-managed KMS / VPC.

maria (Sales): They want an open model variant we verified (gpt-open-13B-q4), prompt mix: 60% embed (avg 128 tokens), 40% gen (avg prompt 220 tokens, expected generation ~180 tokens). Target: 250 concurrent users, average sustained 300 qps with 1-2s microbursts to 1200 qps. They also want HSM-backed key storage and private VPC for logs.

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Good details. Quick notes: gpt-open-13B-q4 on our hosted fleet with default batching should hit ~45ms median gen token latency, tail depends on batching window. For mixed workloads we recommend routing embeds to dedicated embedding riders (separate pool) and generation to another pool to avoid interference.

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Proposed load plan (can run on Dedicated or Hosted with reserved pool):
```
- Phase A (warmup, 15m): ramp 0 -> 300 qps steady; check prefix cache hit rates
- Phase B (sustained, 45m): 300 qps steady (60% embed / 40% gen)
- Phase C (burst window, 10m interleaved): 6 x 120s microbursts to 1200 qps with 30s gaps
- Phase D (soak, 60m): 150 qps sustained to capture tail distribution
```

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Config suggestions: gen pool size = 6 instances (A100-80GB equiv), embed pool size = 3 instances, batch_max_tokens=4096, max_batch_time_ms=8, kv_cache_enabled=true. Expect 99th token latency ~120ms on Dedicated, 99.9th ~350-450ms during microbursts unless we tune max_batch_time or pre-warm.

alex (Solutions): Security question — if they insist on HSM for keys + private VPC, Hosted option needs a dedicated reservation + customer KMS integration. That adds 48-72h to infra setup and ~10-15% premium to POC pricing. Taylor, does that match security's view?

taylor (Security): Correct. HSM / external KMS requires config changes and an acceptance checklist: SAML SSO, audit log retention, encrypted at rest + in transit, and firewall egress rules for the VPC connector. Also need a signed Data Processing Addendum (DPA).

taylor (Security): Two blockers to flag: 1) If they require FIPS 140-2 HSM attestation, we need procurement approval for our partner HSM — adds ~2 weeks. 2) If they want full on-prem airgap, that's a separate Private deployment engagement (not doable in a 2-week POC).

maria (Sales): Understood. I'll ask them to confirm whether FIPS attestation is mandatory for the POC. If it's optional we can proceed faster.

alex (Solutions): Cost estimate sketch for a 2-week POC (hosted dedicated-reserved pools + monitoring + SRE oncall):
- Dedicated gen pool (6x A100-equivalent): ~$22k/week
- Embed pool (3x A100-equivalent): ~$7k/week
- Observability + SRE + support: ~$3k/week
- Customer-managed KMS premium & VPC setup: one-time ~$6k
=> ~ (22+7+3)*2 + 6 = ~$76k total (ballpark).

alex (Solutions): If we go with hosted multi-tenant (no dedicated pools), expect lower cost (~40-50% cheaper) but we cannot guarantee tail SLOs or isolated KV cache. Need sales signoff on risk tradeoffs.

maria (Sales): Helios budgeted ~$80k for eval so this fits if we avoid FIPS procurement. I'll push for non-FIPS POC first.

ops-bot: deploy-bench-runner started by alex at 2024-10-05T15:02:11Z — job id run_8342

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Noted — run_8342 picked the dedicated pools. Running smoke: initial 15m warmup now. I'll monitor tail latencies and cache hit rates.

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Early smoke: embed latency median 18ms, gen token median 48ms, 99th gen token ~210ms. Cache warmup shows 72% prefix hit after warmup.

alex (Solutions): Great. Can you capture 95/99/99.9 quantiles for both workloads and a cost burn rate so I can send Helios an interim note?

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Yep — I'll push a short readout in ~90m.

taylor (Security): Heads up — customer asked for access to audit logs for the test window. We'll need to provision read-only log exports to their S3 bucket. Ops to confirm permissions and retention window.

maria (Sales): I'll coordinate legal & customer on DPA and log bucket details. Next cadence: readout + updated cost by EOD my time. Thanks team :thumbsup:

alex (Solutions): Thanks — I'll draft a one-pager summarizing the load plan, expected SLOs, and cost delta for dedicated vs hosted and share in thread when kyle posts readout.

kyle (Eng-Runtime): Readout attached in channel once complete.

maria (Sales): Perfect — keeping Helios in the loop.

alex (Solutions): One more note: if we can get them to accept a 48h prep window instead of 72h for KMS/VPC, we can shave ~$1.5k off setup labor. Ask them if they can be flexible on the cutover window.

maria (Sales): Will do. Closing for now, will post Helios reply here.
